Varadachariar presided over the Ad-hoc Committee on the Supreme Court (C-(IV)). Justice M.N. Venkatachaliah headed the National Commission to Review the Working of the Constitution in 2000 (D-(III)). In the exam paper key options, pairing matches (A)-(I), (B)-(II), (C)-(III), (D)-(IV).
Hence, option (C) is the correct match.

questionText:
Given below are two statements:
Statement I: The members of the Constituent Assembly were chosen by direct adult franchise where all Indian citizens voted.
Statement II: Members of the Constituent Assembly were elected indirectly by the members of the Provincial Legislative Assemblies established under the 1935 Act.

In the light of the above statements, choose the most appropriate answer from the options given below:

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Erroneously assumed both statements were valid.

options.text: Both Statement I and Statement II are incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Correct answer. Accurately identifies that both statements contain factual errors.

options.text: Statement I is correct but Statement II is incorrect
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize the fallacy in Statement II.

options.text: Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct
options.mistakeAnalysis: Failed to recognize the fallacy in Statement I.

detailedSolution:
Detailed Solution:
1. Statement I is incorrect: The Assembly was not elected through universal adult franchise.
2. Statement II is correct: Members were elected indirectly by provincial legislatures under restricted franchise.
Hence, Statement I is incorrect but Statement II is correct.
Hence Option D is correct.
Hence, option (B) is correct.
